metadata.question: In the Norwegian Sea during Septermber 1, 2019, is the water color at (50.282684, -58.944881) more milky than (50.415337, -54.128047)?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Use Sentinel-2 MSI data (best for water color/turbidity analysis) - Filter for September 1, 2019 (±a few days for cloud-free availability) - Two locations: (50.282684, -58.944881) and (50.415337, -54.128047) in Norwegian Sea - "Milky" water typically indicates high suspended sediment, measured by turbidity or spectral indices 2. **Masking strategy**: - Mask clouds (QA60 band) to get valid water pixels - Focus on blue/green bands sensitive to suspended matter - Use a turbidity proxy (e.g., B4/B3 ratio or normalized difference indices) 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null**: - Check image collection size first - After cloud masking, check pixel count per location - Calculate turbidity index (higher = milkier water) - Compare the two values: if location 1 > location 2, answer A; else B - If any location has 0 valid pixels → C2 - If collection is empty → C1 - If calculation returns NaN/None → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the two locations in Norwegian Sea const loc1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-58.944881, 50.282684]); const loc2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-54.128047, 50.415337]); // Time period: September 1, 2019 ± 5 days for cloud-free image const startDate = '2019-08-27'; const endDate = '2019-09-05'; // Sentinel-2 MSI collection let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(loc1.buffer(50000)) .filterMetadata('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 'less_than', 50); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No data available for September 1, 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Cloud mask function (QA60) function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; return img.updateMask(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))) .divide(10000); // Scale reflectance } // Get median composite (best available) const composite = col.map(maskClouds).median(); // Turbidity index: (Red + Green) / Blue (higher = milkier/more suspended matter) // Using B4 (Red), B3 (Green), B2 (Blue) const turbidityIndex = composite.select('B4').add(composite.select('B3')) .divide(composite.select('B2')); // Calculate turbidity at location 1 const stats1 = turbidityIndex.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: loc1, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount1 = composite.select('B2').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: loc1, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const turbidity1 = stats1['B4'] !== undefined ? stats1['B4'] : null; const count1 = pixelCount1['B2'] || 0; console.log(`Location 1 (${-58.944881}, ${50.282684}): Turbidity=${turbidity1 !== null ? turbidity1.toFixed(3) : 'N/A'}, Pixels=${count1}`); // Calculate turbidity at location 2 const stats2 = turbidityIndex.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: loc2, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const pixelCount2 = composite.select('B2').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: loc2, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const turbidity2 = stats2['B4'] !== undefined ? stats2['B4'] : null; const count2 = pixelCount2['B2'] || 0; console.log(`Location 2 (${-54.128047}, ${50.415337}): Turbidity=${turbidity2 !== null ? turbidity2.toFixed(3) : 'N/A'}, Pixels=${count2}`); // Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking at one or both locations'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (turbidity1 === null || turbidity2 === null || isNaN(turbidity1) || isNaN(turbidity2)) { console.log('Calculation failure: invalid turbidity values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Location 1 more milky than Location 2? const isMoreMilky = turbidity1 > turbidity2; console.log(`Turbidity comparison: ${turbidity1.toFixed(3)} vs ${turbidity2.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(isMoreMilky ? 'A' : 'B'); } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
